Publish.LongDescription:
⚠️ **This is the development build of _Traffic: Clear the Way_. It is not the mod you want.**
Install the normal release instead - this page exists so testers can try changes before they ship.
- Expect rough edges: unfinished behaviour, debug logging, values that change between uploads. - Do **not** run it on a city you care about. Keep a backup save. - Never run it alongside the release version - both register the same systems.
Feedback on a dev build is most useful with `Logs/ClearTheWay.log` attached (switch on "Verbose logging" in the options first).
Release version: https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/151583/Windows
Publish.ChangeLog:
0.1.14.0 - tow trucks that drive home, and a cheaper main pass.
**Tow trucks no longer stand still after hooking a wreck** A loaded tow truck often stood still right after hooking its wreck, with the road ahead apparently free, and was removed about ten seconds later. That has been there since towing exists - it was not a rare case, it was the normal one: - An accident is almost always two cars. The truck arrives from behind, hooks the rear one, and the front one still stands on its lane. The game plans a returning vehicle's route around blocked lanes, so there was no way home at all, and our own safety net removed the truck. - The truck now gets a route that leads past the second wreck, pulls out beside it (away from it, or toward the centre line when it stands dead ahead), passes it and moves back into its lane once the wreck is behind it. - After a wreck has been towed away, the spot it stood on is released for the rest of the traffic. The game kept treating the lane as blocked until something else updated it.
**Performance** - Every component read in the mod was rebuilt around one cached lookup per component type instead of the game's general-purpose access. Measured in a city of about 570,000: pulling cars aside costs half as much per car, the main pass 18 to 40 percent less at comparable load.
**Fixes** - An error message when the camera followed a tow truck the mod was removing.
**Performance measurement is ON in this dev build** All timers in the Performance tab are switched on by default, including the new "Waiting for game jobs" (how long the mod waits for the game's own jobs, per component type). That costs a little frame time; "All off" turns everything off. The release build will have them off again.
**What to report** Logs/ClearTheWay.log, the city size, and roughly how many emergency vehicles and wrecks were on the map. - A tow truck that stands still with a wreck on its hook, or one that is removed. "[towpass]" lines show the truck passing a second wreck. - A truck that swings left and right beside a wreck instead of passing it. - Short regular stutters: please note the time, so they can be matched against the log.
